{
  "screen_decision": "include",
  "screen_rationale": "The study performs a systematic review and meta-analysis of quantitative data from in vivo animal and human models to compare IRAK3 expression and inflammatory cytokine expression in sepsis, which directly measures agreement between animal and human models regarding treatment effects on these biomarkers.",
  "arm": "methods-and-bias",
  "arm_evidence": "The review compares findings from in vitro cell culture and in vivo animal models to human models, assessing the translatability of these models to human outcomes.",
  "therapeutic_areas": [
    "sepsis-inflammation",
    "infectious-disease"
  ],
  "areas_evidence": "The study focuses on \"sepsis\" and its \"inflammatory\" responses, and sepsis is caused by \"infections\".",
  "model_type": "across-multiple-models",
  "model_evidence": "The study includes \"in vivo human models\", \"rodents (mice or rats)\", \"sheep\", \"cows\", and \"pigs\", and compares findings between these different model types.",
  "species": [
    "mouse",
    "rat",
    "sheep",
    "cattle",
    "pig",
    "non-human-primate"
  ],
  "species_evidence": "The study explicitly mentions \"rodents (mice or rats)\", \"sheep\", \"cows\", and \"pigs\" as species used in the included studies. It also mentions \"human in vivo studies\" and refers to \"non-human-primate\" in the context of general discussion on animal models.",
  "endpoint_class": "secondary-biomarker",
  "endpoint_evidence": "The study measures \"IRAK3 mRNA and protein expression\", \"TNF-α mRNA expression and protein level\", and \"IL-6 protein level\", which are biomarkers of inflammation."
}
